title: useStack Hook
description:
Implement a `useStack` hook that manages a LIFO stack and returns `{ stack, push, pop, peek, size }`. `push(item)` adds to the top. `pop()` removes the top item. `peek` is the top item (or `undefined` if empty). `size` is the current length.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { stack, push, pop, peek, size } = useStack([]);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: confusing which end is the 'top' — in a stack modeled as an array, the top is the last element (index -1), so peek is stack[stack.length - 1] and pop removes the last element with slice(0, -1).
